facts.fact: 跪祷：第二太阳升起全街跪拜——Nikolas/Rian 肌肉记忆跟随（双手圈日+Solari 祷词 Light is life...Honorable Risäl）；Rian 只动唇不出声；眨眼时太阳残像绕弟成环。
facts.anchor: Light is life, light is longevity

facts.fact: 交还武器：Edwin 班卓琴藏弩箭被没收、Angelica 琴验明放行；Sunbringer Spear 由 Varrick 摘下——「not one feather...but two...as a brother...I will allow you to bear it in Lord Phos’s name」——Nikolas 接矛（空眼窝刺痛、矛暖掌心）；「And so the Sunbringer shall seek out the Sunslayer. What poetic times we live in.」
facts.anchor: “You carry not one feather from the Daystar, but two,”

facts.fact: Clockwork Bazaar：Devisers 发明区（传送杯垫/黑沙漏/汽笛玩具）；墙上通缉令「Beware the Sunslayer」——Taesia 被画成獠牙笑的阴影人形持棘剑——Attack on sight。
Fin 的追问：手链已断（「Shit, your charm. I lost it in Nexus」）——「meant something to each other,」——「Once」——「I like her」（指 Ulshära：honorable/compassionate）。

巷口遇敌：Faün（ost Vonlin 将军、造军团者）挡门——「The ost Vonlins are more than prepared to supply him with whatever he needs. Make him see reason. Unless you’d rather collaborate with us instead, Your Eminence.」——Ulshära 背后握拳。
facts.anchor: Unless you’d rather collaborate with us instead,

facts.fact: Oskar：Ulshära 二表哥、最强 Deviser（轮椅 mobility aid+多层单片镜）；赠玻璃义眼——「It won’t restore your sight, but it balances your depth perception. It also detects when others are using magic.」——Rian 抢先收进口袋（「doesn't hurt to have the option」）。
大揭秘：ost Krülins 建了 Dawn Throne——图纸只可能在 Aphelion Tower（Varrick 家最先赞助、其祖父委托 Oskar 之父造 arquebuses）——「the key to unseating Phos lies in the very thing that seats him」。
facts.anchor: They were the ones who built the Dawn Throne.

facts.fact: 工作台惊雷：Rian 揭出金版手持 arquebuses（Oskar 之父发明、ost Vonlins 想量产）——Oskar 血色尽失：「Step away.」
